STOPPED under plan section 22 before any source change: the approved architecture has no canonical derivation by which the AGENT can compute the wire binding_digest. evaluate_protected_operation step 4 (operation_contract.rs:1449-1452) requires request.binding_digest() to equal facts.expected_binding_digest(), which is sha256 over project, repository, plan, plan_digest, phase, candidate_digest, operation, model_policy, credential_ref. Seven of those nine are opaque 32-byte values the Host resolves through ports whose production adapters do not exist, and no identifier-to-digest or committed-candidate-to-digest rule exists anywhere in the host tree (only the four domain tags host-request-binding, host-request-replay, owner-programme-delegation, programme-identity; the composition tests use fixture constants 0x11, 0x22 and so on). The agent side has no binding_digest notion at all. A transport that can only agree with fixture digests would be a dead production route, so closing this needs a THIRD ratified contract addition beyond amendments 1 and 2. No runtime source was changed, nothing was committed.

Owner ratified the committed-candidate digest contract: sha256(one versioned ProjectOS committed-candidate domain + u32 big-endian schema version 1 + 40 validated lowercase ASCII hex commit OID bytes); no tree id, no working-tree substitute, no generic identifier hashing, binding_digest and the fixed IPC frame unchanged. Recorded here rather than in a new governance file. Implementation did NOT resume: plan section 8 stop condition fired during pre-implementation verification. OwnerProgrammeDelegation documents project, repository, plan, allowed_phases, model_policy and credential_ref as DIGESTS OF IDENTIFIERS (operation_contract.rs:647-665: 'Digest of the project id', 'Digest of the canonical repository identity', 'Digest of the exact plan id', 'Digests of the phase ids'). No rule for hashing an identifier into those 32 bytes exists anywhere in the tree; every test uses constants. The section 7 preferred route is also the wrong digest kind: host-core phase_definition_digest hashes 19 normalized-definition fields, so a facts.phase built from it could never satisfy the step 5 membership test against a digest of the phase id. Six of the nine binding-subject inputs therefore have no Host-side derivation, and supplying one is the identifier convention section 8 forbids inventing. No source changed.

gatekeeper final source-truth ruling: phase = phase_identity_digest(phase_id) and plan = plan_identity_digest(plan_ref) under the existing projectos.programme-identity.v1 domain via NEW TYPED helpers only (identity_digest stays private, no caller-selectable field tag); plan_digest = the already-validated ApprovedPlanBinding phase-definition digest bytes via the narrowest read-only accessor; NO PlanRecordDto field and NO PLAN_RECORD_SCHEMA bump; committed-candidate contract unchanged
